messages:
jamie: Heads-up — NIGHT maintenance tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Were doing a link-diversion test in us-east2 (flip traffic to alternate egress path) and a KV-cache warmup across affected pools. Expect rolling node drains in small cohorts, brief throughput dip (~5-10%) for ~10–15m per cohort. I'll share the cohort schedule in a sec.

lia: Which pools/tenants are in cohort1? Are dedicated/reserved pools excluded?

matt: Cohort map (short): canary = 2 nodes in saturn-pool (interactive); cohort1 = next 6 nodes (saturn + orbit mix); cohort2 = next 6. Dedicated/reserved pools + heavy-IO tenants excluded. Preemptible/backfill pools also excluded.

serena: Cost angle — will we spin up extra burst GPUs or shift models to quantized variants during the window?

jamie: Cost expectation: small bump — ~0.5% spend for KV preheat + potential ephemeral backfill if we need to absorb load. No planned model variant shifts, but fallback policy: if latency > 300ms for 2m we'll route to dedicated fallback model 'redwood-small-v2-q4'. We prefer routing over deploying new versions.

matt: On-call ops notes: run standard cordon/drain flow for evacs. Example commands for canary: 

```
# canary drain
kubectl cordon node-abc123
kubectl drain node-abc123 --ignore-daemonsets --force --delete-local-data
```

Also: ensure KV seed job runs after drain completes: `curl -X POST http://infra-runner/kv/seed?pool=saturn`

lia: I'll update the status page and post the customer comms draft to #customer-success. Draft link: https://status.redwood.ai/drafts/1750123456. Ping @alex for pager coverage.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance auto-notice queued to #statuspage for 01:50 UTC :white_check_mark:

jamie: Timeline: 02:00 canary (2 nodes) -> 02:20 cohort1 (6 nodes) -> 02:50 cohort2 (6 nodes) -> 03:20 final sweep + post-checks. Post-check pass criteria: KV hitrate >= 0.90 and per-route p50 < 200ms. If pass, we mark complete; if not, fallback/rollback as discussed.

serena: If we see >10% error increase, plan = rollback traffic diversion immediately and re-seed cache from latest snapshot. Also capture a perf/cost delta for finance.

matt: I'll run a short gray traffic test to exercise fallback routes before canary. Will attach logs here when done.

lia: :thumbsup: tagging pager @alex for coverage.

alex: I'll be on call for the window, reachable on PD and slack. Set me as second pager.

jamie: Thanks all. Reminder: no customer-facing releases during window. I'll post final cohort map and the debrief (incl. cost summary + any follow-ups) after the run.
